I come from a land in which history was carved into stone, and in which geographical challenges were transformed into opportunities for civilisations to meet.

This same spirit, this spirit that seeks to bring together, is the spirit that brings us here today.
I am appearing at the General Assembly of the United Nations today for the first time.
Only 57 days ago, I had the honour of assuming the presidency of the Republic of Peru.
Mine is a proud and resilient people and we are a founding member state of this organization.
